hotspots.name: The Shop Door
hotspots.description: The constables broke the frame to get in. The bolt is still thrown, still seated in its housing, and the housing came away with the wood.

hotspots.name: Shuttered Window
hotspots.description: Nailed from the inside, and recently — the heads are bright, and the wood around them has not weathered.

hotspots.name: Ezra Halloway
hotspots.description: Sixty-one years old, laid out where he fell behind his own counter. The undertaker has been twice and has twice failed to do anything about his face.

hotspots.name: A Pocket-Watch
hotspots.description: Lying open where his right hand fell away from it. A good watch, a gentleman's watch, and no gentleman has been in this shop in years.

hotspots.name: The Counter
hotspots.description: Scrubbed deal, worn to a hollow where thirty-one years of elbows have rested.

hotspots.name: Halloway's Ledger
hotspots.description: Open at the fourteenth. Every pledge, every redemption, every forfeit, in a hand that does not vary — until it does.

hotspots.name: Japanned Strongbox
hotspots.description: Bolted to the underside of the counter, where a man keeps the day's takings and does not mention it.

locked.reason: It is locked, and the key is not on the body. Constable Rell has the ring.

hotspots.name: The Cellar Stair
hotspots.description: Bare treads going down into the coal dark. Somebody has been up and down them since the last delivery.

hotspots.name: Display Case
hotspots.description: Unredeemed pledges under glass: a christening spoon, a surgeon's lancet, three wedding rings, and a jet mourning ring with braided hair under the stone.
